instruction.text: Select the correct area on the picture.

finish.text: All the consumers and producers you just found are part of an ecosystem. An ecosystem is an area where plants, animals and other organisms live together and interact with one another.
finish.sound: All the consumers and producers you just found are part of an ecosystem. An ecosystem is an area where plants, animals and other organisms liv together, and interact with one another.

feedback.correct: This plant is a producer. That means it uses the Sun’s energy to grow and produce energy by itself.
The mouse is a consumer. It eats plants and small insects to get energy.
This owl is a consumer. That means it consumes other living things, such as mice, to get energy.
The fox is a consumer. It eats other animals to get food, for example owls.

atoms.b: Plants are ((++producers consumers)). Plants use energy from the Sun to produce food by themselves.
All animals are ((producers ++consumers)). That means they must eat other living things to survive.
Not all animals have the same diet though. For example, herbivorous animals only consume plants, carnivorous animals only eat ((++meat seeds)), and omnivorous animals consume ((++both grass)).
